metadata.title: On Diameter Graphs Problems: A proof of Brass's Conjecture
metadata.abstract: The diameter graph of a finite set $S\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ has vertex set $S$ and two points are adjacent when their distance equals $\operatorname{diam} S$. In this paper we study the following question: given $k$ and $d$, is there a constant $c=c(k,d)$ such that from every finite point set $S\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ one can remove at most $c$ points so that the subgraph of the diameter graph induced by the remaining points is $k$-colorable? Brass conjectured that such a constant exists for $d=3$ and $k=3$. We prove this conjecture by showing that at most one point needs to be removed. We also answer a question of Dol'nikov, showing that for every positive integer $m$, there exist a finite point set $S\subset\mathbb{R}^3$ in which every subset of smaller diameter has less than $(|S|-m)/2$ points.

analysis.progressType: 三维直径图删一点后的三着色声称
analysis.workSummary: 对R³中有限点集，以达到集合直径的点对连边。作者证明删去至多一个点即可使直径图三着色，从而回答Brass关于有限删点数的猜想。
techniques: 三维直径图的几何约束
较小直径子集的极端构造
analysis.breakthrough: 删点数可统一取1。另回答Dol’nikov问题，对任意正整数m构造有限S，使每个直径严格较小的子集的点数都小于(|S|−m)/2。
analysis.limitations: Brass结论的范围为d=3、k=3。独立集上界构造的点数随m变化，全文论证仍需核对。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.priorityReason: 涉及Borsuk型直径划分和三维图几何，结论强，优先核对核心定理及极端构造。
